dsa_fundamentals.arrays: Arrays store elements in contiguous memory. Access O(1), insert/delete O(n). Use when need fast random access.
dsa_fundamentals.linked_lists: Linked lists use nodes with pointers. Insert/delete O(1) with pointer, access O(n). Use when frequent insertions at beginning.
dsa_fundamentals.stacks: LIFO (Last-In-First-Out). Push O(1), pop O(1). Uses: function calls, undo/redo, expression evaluation.
dsa_fundamentals.queues: FIFO (First-In-First-Out). Enqueue O(1), dequeue O(1). Uses: BFS, task scheduling, message queues.
dsa_fundamentals.binary_search_trees: BST: left < node < right. Search/insert/delete O(log n) balanced. Unbalanced degrades to O(n).
dsa_fundamentals.hashing: Hash table distributes elements via hash function. O(1) average case. Handle collisions: chaining or open addressing.
dsa_fundamentals.heaps: Min/Max heap binary tree. Insert/delete O(log n). Uses: priority queue, heap sort, Dijkstra's.
dsa_fundamentals.graphs: Nodes and edges. Directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted. Traverse: BFS (queue), DFS (stack).
dsa_fundamentals.sorting_algorithms: Bubble, Selection, Insertion O(n²). Merge, Quick O(n log n). Heap O(n log n). Counting, Radix O(n).
dsa_fundamentals.searching: Linear search O(n), binary search O(log n) on sorted. Interpolation search O(log log n) on uniform.
dsa_fundamentals.dynamic_programming: Break problem into subproblems. Memoize solutions avoid recomputation. Example: Fibonacci, knapsack, LCS.
dsa_fundamentals.greedy_algorithms: Choose locally optimal at each step. Works only with optimal substructure, greedy choice property. Activity selection.
dsa_fundamentals.backtracking: Try all possibilities, abandon promising branches. N-Queens, sudoku solver. Time: exponential but with pruning.
dsa_fundamentals.bit_manipulation: Techniques: AND, OR, XOR, shift, mask. Used in: flags, optimizations, cryptography.
dsa_fundamentals.two_pointers: Technique for sorted arrays. Find pairs, remove duplicates, partition. O(n) solution for many problems.
dsa_fundamentals.sliding_window: Maintain window of elements. Substring matching, max subarray. Reduces nested loop to O(n).
dsa_fundamentals.segment_tree: Efficient range query structure. Build O(n log n), query O(log n), update O(log n). Alternative to prefix sum.
dsa_fundamentals.fenwick_tree: Binary Indexed Tree. Compact segment tree. O(log n) update and prefix query. Space-efficient.
dsa_fundamentals.union_find: Disjoint sets with union, find operations. Path compression and union by rank O(α(n)) ≈ O(1).
dsa_fundamentals.trie: Tree storing strings. Insert/search O(m) where m=length. Uses: autocomplete, prefix search, dictionary.

web_development.html_basics: HyperText Markup Language structures web content. Semantic tags: header, nav, main, article, footer. Forms: input, select, textarea.
web_development.css_styling: Cascading Style Sheets format presentation. Specificity, cascade, inheritance. Flexbox and Grid for layouts. Responsive design.
web_development.javascript_fundamentals: Dynamic web language. Event handling, DOM manipulation, AJAX. Scoping, hoisting, event loop.
web_development.react: Facebook UI library using components. Hooks: useState, useEffect, useContext. Virtual DOM, reconciliation. JSX syntax.
web_development.vue_framework: Progressive framework. Reactive data binding, component-based. Directives: v-if, v-for, v-on. Simpler than React.
web_development.angular: Full framework from Google. TypeScript-based. Dependency injection, services, RxJS for reactive. Steep learning curve.
web_development.nodejs_backend: Server-side JavaScript runtime. Built on V8 engine. Event-driven, non-blocking I/O. NPM ecosystem.
web_development.express_server: Minimal web framework Node. Middleware pattern, routing, request/response. Popular choice for APIs.
web_development.rest_api: Architectural style with resources and HTTP methods. Stateless, cacheable. Standard practices for building web services.
web_development.graphql_api: Query language for APIs. Single endpoint. Query only needed fields, prevents over-fetching. Strongly typed.
web_development.authentication: Verify user identity. Methods: password, OAuth, JWT, SSO. Secure storage: hash passwords with salt.
web_development.authorization: Control what authenticated user can do. RBAC (Role-Based), ABAC (Attribute-Based). Implement in middleware.
web_development.websockets: Full-duplex communication over TCP. Real-time apps: chat, notifications, collaborative tools. Lower latency than polling.
web_development.progressive_web_app: Web app with app-like features. Service workers for offline, manifest for installation. Native-like UX.
web_development.accessibility: Design for all users including disabled. WCAG guidelines. Keyboard navigation, screen readers, color contrast.
web_development.performance_optimization: Techniques: minification, compression, lazy loading, code splitting. Tools: Webpack, Rollup. Monitor with Lighthouse.
web_development.static_site_generation: Pre-render pages to static HTML. SEO friendly, fast. Tools: Next.js, Hugo, Jekyll. Ideal for blogs.
web_development.server_side_rendering: Render HTML on server. Initial page fast, SEO good. Trade-off: server load. Frameworks: Next.js, Nuxt.js.
web_development.seo_basics: Search Engine Optimization. Meta tags, structured data, sitemap, robots.txt. Clean URLs, mobile-friendly. Content quality.
web_development.responsive_design: Mobile-first design adapts to screen size. Media queries, flexible grids. CSS Grid and Flexbox modern approach.

database_systems.relational_databases: Organize data in tables with relationships. SQL queries. ACID transactions. Examples: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle.
database_systems.nosql_databases: Non-relational, flexible schema. Types: document (MongoDB), key-value (Redis), column (Cassandra). BASE properties.
database_systems.sql_basics: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE. WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY. Sub-queries, CTEs, window functions.
database_systems.normalization: Process reducing redundancy. 1NF (atomic values), 2NF (no partial keys), 3NF (no transitive dependencies). BCNF stricter.
database_systems.indexing: Data structure for fast lookup. B-tree, hash, bitmap indexes. Trade-off: faster reads but slower writes and more storage.
database_systems.query_optimization: EXPLAIN PLAN analyzes queries. Use indexes, avoid full table scans. Query rewriting, statistics.
database_systems.transactions: ACID properties. Atomicity: all or nothing. Consistency: valid states. Isolation: concurrent independence. Durability: persistent.
database_systems.locking: Prevent concurrent access issues. Pessimistic: lock resources. Optimistic: retry if conflict. Deadlock prevention.
database_systems.replication: Copy data across servers. Master-slave (read scaling), multi-master (write scaling). Synchronous vs asynchronous.
database_systems.sharding: Horizontal partitioning across servers. Range-based, hash-based, directory-based. Scalability but complex joins.
database_systems.backup_recovery: Regular snapshots, WAL for recovery. Point-in-time restore. Geographically distributed for disaster recovery.
database_systems.mongodb_document: Document database storing JSON-like BSON. Flexible schema. Indexing, aggregation pipeline, transactions (recent).
database_systems.redis_cache: In-memory key-value store. Fast but volatile. Persistence: RDB snapshots, AOF. Pub/Sub, Lua scripting.
database_systems.cassandra_distributed: Distributed column-family store. High availability, horizontal scaling. Eventual consistency, no JOIN support.
database_systems.elasticsearch_search: Distributed search and analytics engine. Inverted index for full-text search. RESTful API, JSON documents.
database_systems.database_triggers: Stored procedures triggered by events. Enforce business rules, maintain audit logs, referential integrity.
database_systems.stored_procedures: Precompiled SQL code on database. Reusable, network efficient. Language: PL/SQL (Oracle), T-SQL (SQL Server).
database_systems.views: Virtual tables from query result. Simplify complex queries, provide abstraction, enforce security.
database_systems.constraint_enforcement: Primary key, foreign key, unique, check, not null. Database prevents invalid data.
database_systems.connection_pooling: Reuse database connections. Reduce overhead of creating connections. Config: min size, max size, timeout.

machine_learning.supervised_learning: Learning from labeled data. Regression (continuous), classification (discrete). Algorithms: linear regression, SVM, decision trees.
machine_learning.unsupervised_learning: Learning from unlabeled data. Clustering, dimensionality reduction. Algorithms: K-means, hierarchical, PCA.
machine_learning.reinforcement_learning: Learn by interaction with environment. Reward signal guides learning. Algorithms: Q-learning, policy gradient.
machine_learning.neural_networks: Layers of neurons with weights. Forward pass computations, backpropagation updates weights. Deep learning: many hidden layers.
machine_learning.convolutional_neural_networks: CNN for image processing. Convolutional layers extract features. Pooling reduces dimension. Spatial locality.
machine_learning.recurrent_neural_networks: RNN processes sequences. Hidden state carries information. LSTM/GRU improve gradient flow. Uses: NLP, time series.
machine_learning.transformers: Attention mechanism without recurrence. Parallel processing, captures long-range dependencies. Foundation of BERT, GPT.
machine_learning.attention_mechanism: Focus on relevant parts of input. Query, key, value computations. Self-attention, multi-head attention.
machine_learning.loss_function: Measures prediction error. Regression: MSE, MAE. Classification: cross-entropy. Important for learning.
machine_learning.optimization_algorithms: SGD, Momentum, Adam, RMSprop. Adjust learning rate, accumulate gradients. Adam popular choice.
machine_learning.activation_functions: Introduce non-linearity. ReLU (popular), sigmoid, tanh. Choose based on output range, gradient properties.
machine_learning.regularization: Prevent overfitting. L1/L2 penalty on weights, dropout random neurons, early stopping. Improves generalization.
machine_learning.batch_normalization: Normalize layer inputs. Stabilize training, allow higher learning rates. Reduces internal covariate shift.
machine_learning.dropout: Randomly deactivate neurons during training. Prevents co-adaptation. Effective regularization technique.
machine_learning.transfer_learning: Use pre-trained model, fine-tune on new task. Faster training, better performance. ImageNet models for vision.
machine_learning.cross_validation: Split data into k folds, train k models. Average scores for reliable evaluation. Prevents overfitting.
machine_learning.hyperparameter_tuning: Adjust learning rate, batch size, layers, epochs. Grid search, random search, Bayesian optimization.
machine_learning.class_imbalance: When classes have different sizes. Techniques: oversampling minority, undersampling majority, SMOTE, class weights.
machine_learning.evaluation_metrics: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, AUC-ROC. Choose based on problem type and cost.
machine_learning.ensemble_methods: Combine models for better prediction. Bagging (Random Forest), boosting (Gradient Boosting), stacking.

cloud_platforms.aws_services: Compute (EC2, Lambda), Storage (S3, EBS), Database (RDS, DynamoDB), Networking (VPC, Route53), Analytics (Redshift).
cloud_platforms.gcp_google: Compute (Compute Engine, Cloud Functions), Storage (Cloud Storage), Database (Cloud SQL, Firestore), Big Data.
cloud_platforms.azure_microsoft: Compute (VMs, App Service), Storage (Blob), Database (SQL Database, Cosmos DB), AI services.
cloud_platforms.ec2_instance: Virtual machine on AWS. Choose instance type, storage, security groups. Elastic IP, auto-scaling groups.
cloud_platforms.s3_storage: Object storage for files, backups, websites. Cheap, durable, scalable. Versioning, lifecycle policies, static hosting.
cloud_platforms.lambda_serverless: Function as a Service. Pay per execution. Trigger via API, S3, DynamoDB, schedule. Limited execution time.
cloud_platforms.rds_database: Managed relational database. Automatic backups, failover, patching. Supports: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server.
cloud_platforms.dynamodb_nosql: Managed NoSQL database. Key-value and document models. Serverless scaling, on-demand or provisioned.
cloud_platforms.vpc_networking: Virtual Private Cloud isolated network. Subnets, security groups, NAT gateway, VPN. Control traffic.
cloud_platforms.api_gateway: Managed service to create APIs. Handle routing, auth, throttling, logging. Integrate with Lambda, EC2.
cloud_platforms.cloudfront_cdn: Global CDN for content delivery. Low latency, reduced bandwidth. Cache from edge locations worldwide.
cloud_platforms.iam_access: Identity and Access Management. Users, roles, policies. Least privilege principle. Enable MFA.
cloud_platforms.cloudwatch_monitoring: Collect metrics, logs, events. Create alarms, dashboards. Monitor resources and applications.
cloud_platforms.autoscaling: Automatically adjust compute capacity. Policies: target tracking, step scaling. Respond to demand changes.
cloud_platforms.containers_ecs: EC2 Container Service manages Docker containers. Easier than Kubernetes. Integrate with load balancer.
cloud_platforms.kubernetes_orchestration: Orchestrate containerized apps. Pods, services, deployments. Self-healing, scaling, rolling updates.
cloud_platforms.terraform_iac: Infrastructure as Code. Declarative language to provision resources. Version control infrastructure.
cloud_platforms.cloudformation_stack: AWS service for infrastructure as code. JSON/YAML templates. Managed stack updates, rollback.
cloud_platforms.cost_optimization: Right-sizing instances, reserved instances, spot instances. Delete unused resources. Monitor costs.
cloud_platforms.disaster_recovery: RTO (Recovery Time Objective), RPO (Recovery Point Objective). Multi-region redundancy, backups.

devops_practices.version_control_git: Track code changes over time. Distributed system with commit history. Branching, merging, tags.
devops_practices.git_workflow: Git Flow (develop, main), GitHub Flow (main + features), trunk-based. Choose based on release cycle.
devops_practices.continuous_integration: Automated testing on each commit. Early bug detection. Build pipeline: compile, test, quality checks.
devops_practices.continuous_deployment: Automatically deploy to production. Environment parity, monitoring. Rapid feedback, frequent releases.
devops_practices.containerization_docker: Package app with dependencies in container. Reproducible, portable, lightweight. Image and container concept.
devops_practices.kubernetes_orchestration: Manage container deployments at scale. Auto-scaling, self-healing, service discovery, configuration.
devops_practices.ci_cd_tools: Jenkins (on-premise), GitLab CI (integrated), GitHub Actions (GitHub native). Pipelines defined as code.
devops_practices.monitoring_logging: Prometheus (metrics), ELK (logs), Grafana (dashboards). Alert on anomalies. Understand system behavior.
devops_practices.infrastructure_code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible. Provision infrastructure via code. Version control, automation, repeatability.
devops_practices.configuration_management: Ansible, Chef, Puppet. Define desired state. Idempotent, scalable configuration.
devops_practices.load_balancing: Distribute traffic across servers. Algorithms: round-robin, least connections, IP hash. High availability.
devops_practices.service_discovery: Automated registration and discovery of services. DNS-based or API-based. Kubernetes built-in.
devops_practices.database_migration: Plan changes to schema. Versioning, rollback capability. Zero-downtime migration strategies.
devops_practices.blue_green_deployment: Two identical environments. Switch traffic instantly. Quick rollback if issues. Higher infrastructure cost.
devops_practices.canary_deployment: Roll out to small user percentage first. Monitor metrics. Gradual expansion or rollback.
devops_practices.feature_flags: Toggle features without code deployment. A/B testing, dark launches, gradual rollout. Decouple deploy and release.
devops_practices.security_scanning: SAST (static), DAST (dynamic), dependency scanning. Integrate in CI/CD pipeline. Vulnerability detection early.
devops_practices.compliance_governance: Standards: SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA. Audit logs, encryption, access control. Compliance automation.
devops_practices.disaster_recovery_planning: RTO/RPO targets, backup frequency, failover procedures. Regular drills, documentation.
devops_practices.incident_management: Alert, respond, investigate, resolve, retrospective. Runbooks, on-call rotation, post-mortems.

system_design.scalability: Vertical: more resources per server (limited). Horizontal: more servers. Database sharding, caching, CDN.
system_design.availability: System uptime percentage. 99.9% = 43 min/month downtime. Redundancy, failover, monitoring important.
system_design.consistency: Strong: all reads see latest write. Eventual: eventually converge. CAP theorem trade-offs.
system_design.load_balancing: Distribute requests across servers. Algorithms, health checks, session affinity. Prevents bottleneck.
system_design.caching_strategy: Fast data lookup. Cache aside, write-through, write-behind. Tools: Redis, Memcached. Invalidation key issue.
system_design.message_queues: Decouple producers and consumers. Asynchronous processing. Tools: RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS. Ensures reliability.
system_design.api_design: RESTful or GraphQL. Versioning, pagination, error codes. Rate limiting, documentation. Consumer-friendly.
system_design.database_design: Normalization vs denormalization. Sharding strategy, replication. Backup and recovery plans.
system_design.microservices: Independent services per business capability. Benefits: scalability, flexibility. Challenges: complexity, testing.
system_design.monolithic_architecture: Single codebase, shared database. Simple deployment, shared resources. Scaling difficult, changes risky.
system_design.event_driven: Services communicate via events. Publish-subscribe, event streaming. Decoupled, scalable. Complexity in ordering.
system_design.real_time_systems: Low latency requirements. WebSockets, streaming data, in-memory processing. Complex to implement.
system_design.batch_processing: Process large data offline. MapReduce, Spark, Hadoop. Cost-effective, slower than real-time.
system_design.search_indexing: Elasticsearch for full-text search. Inverted index, sharding, replication. Configure mapping, analyzer.
system_design.rate_limiting: Protect against abuse and overload. Token bucket, sliding window. Return 429 Too Many Requests.
system_design.circuit_breaker: Fault tolerance pattern. Open (fail-fast), half-open (test), closed (normal). Prevents cascading failures.
system_design.retry_strategy: Automatic retry on failure. Exponential backoff, jitter. Idempotent operations important.
system_design.logging_tracing: Structured logging with correlation IDs. Distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). Debug complex systems.
system_design.sla_agreement: Service Level Agreement specifies expected uptime. SLO (objective), SLI (indicator), error budget.
system_design.capacity_planning: Forecast growth, plan for peak load. Monitor utilization, headroom for spikes. Cost-performance balance.

security_best_practices.authentication_methods: Passwords (weak), MFA, OAuth, SAML, JWT. Authenticate identity, prevent unauthorized access.
security_best_practices.authorization_models: RBAC (roles), ABAC (attributes), PBAC (policy). Principle of least privilege, deny by default.
security_best_practices.encryption: Symmetric (AES-256), asymmetric (RSA). In-transit (TLS), at-rest (database encryption). Key management critical.
security_best_practices.password_security: Hash with salt (bcrypt, Argon2). Strong requirements, regular changes debated. Secure storage crucial.
security_best_practices.sql_injection: Preventive: parameterized queries, prepared statements. Input validation, ORM. Old but still prevalent.
security_best_practices.cross_site_scripting: XSS: inject malicious script. Prevent: sanitize input, escape output, CSP headers. Affects users, not server.
security_best_practices.cross_site_request_forgery: CSRF: trick user to perform action. Prevention: CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies, origin verification.
security_best_practices.secure_communication: HTTPS/TLS for encrypted transport. Certificate validation. Perfect forward secrecy with ephemeral keys.
security_best_practices.secret_management: Store credentials securely. Environment variables, vaults (HashiCorp Vault). Rotate regularly, audit access.
security_best_practices.dependency_security: Monitor library vulnerabilities. Software Composition Analysis (SCA). Update dependencies regularly.
security_best_practices.input_validation: Whitelist validation, length limits, type checks. Server-side validation mandatory. Prevents injection attacks.
security_best_practices.output_encoding: Encode data based on context. HTML, URL, JavaScript, CSS encoding. Prevents XSS.
security_best_practices.api_security: API keys, OAuth tokens. Rate limiting, request signing. CORS configuration, input validation.
security_best_practices.security_headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security. Protect against attacks.
security_best_practices.vulnerability_scanning: Static analysis (SAST), dynamic (DAST), composition (OAST). Automate in CI/CD pipeline.
security_best_practices.penetration_testing: Authorized security testing. Simulate attacker methods. Identify exploitable vulnerabilities.
security_best_practices.incident_response: Plan: prepare, detect, analyze, contain, eradicate, recover. Documentation, training, drills.
security_best_practices.compliance_standards: GDPR (privacy), PCI DSS (payment cards), HIPAA (healthcare). Compliance requirements vary by industry.
security_best_practices.data_privacy: Minimize collection, consent, data retention. Right to be forgotten. Encryption, anonymization.
security_best_practices.access_control: Least privilege, separation of duties. Authentication + Authorization. Regular audit of permissions.

programming_paradigms.object_oriented: Classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation. Modularity, reusability. Languages: Java, C++, Python.
programming_paradigms.functional_programming: First-class functions, immutability, pure functions. Composition, recursion. Languages: Haskell, Lisp, Scala.
programming_paradigms.procedural_programming: Functions, control flow, state. Imperative style. Languages: C, Pascal, procedural style in any language.
programming_paradigms.event_driven: Program flow determined by events. Handlers respond to events. GUI, async I/O. Popular in web browsers.
programming_paradigms.reactive_programming: Data flows through streams. Observe changes, react automatically. RxJS, reactive extensions. Async handling.
programming_paradigms.design_patterns: Reusable solutions to common problems. Creational (Singleton, Factory), Structural (Adapter, Decorator), Behavioral (Observer, Strategy).
programming_paradigms.solid_principles: SRP (single responsibility), OCP (open-closed), LSP (Liskov), ISP (interface segregation), DIP (dependency inversion).
programming_paradigms.clean_code: Readable, maintainable code. Meaningful names, small functions, DRY (don't repeat yourself). Comments when necessary.
programming_paradigms.testing_strategy: Unit tests (fast), integration tests (slower), end-to-end (slowest). Test pyramid: many units, fewer integration.
programming_paradigms.code_review: Peer review before merge. Check logic, style, tests. Share knowledge, catch issues early. Collaborative improvement.
programming_paradigms.refactoring: Improve code structure without changing behavior. Extract methods, rename variables, reduce complexity. Safe with tests.
programming_paradigms.performance_profiling: Measure execution time, memory usage. Identify bottlenecks. Use profilers, benchmarks. Target high-impact areas.
programming_paradigms.version_management: Semantic versioning: major.minor.patch. Breaking changes increment major. Dependency management, compatibility.
programming_paradigms.documentation: Code comments, API docs, README. Architecture decisions, setup instructions. Self-documenting code preferred.
programming_paradigms.error_handling: Try-catch blocks, error codes, exceptions. Fail fast, meaningful messages. Logging for debugging.
programming_paradigms.logging: Different levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR. Structured logs with context. Aggregation and analysis tooling.
programming_paradigms.concurrency: Multithreading, multiprocessing, async. Synchronization: locks, semaphores. Challenges: deadlock, race conditions.
programming_paradigms.memory_management: Manual (C) vs automatic (garbage collection). Prevent leaks, optimize usage. Understanding critical for performance.
programming_paradigms.package_management: Dependency declaration and resolution. Version constraints, transitive dependencies. npm (Node), pip (Python), Maven (Java).
programming_paradigms.build_automation: Compile, test, package in one step. Build scripts, makefiles. CI/CD integration. Reproducible builds.

advanced_concepts.compiler_construction: Lexical analysis, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, code generation. AST, symbol table, optimization.
advanced_concepts.operating_systems: Process management, memory management, file systems, I/O. Scheduling, synchronization, resource allocation.
advanced_concepts.network_protocols: TCP/IP stack, OSI model, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS. Understand layers for troubleshooting.
advanced_concepts.cryptography: Symmetric, asymmetric, hashing, digital signatures. Practical: TLS, HTTPS, JWT. Theory: complexity, algorithms.
advanced_concepts.distributed_systems: Challenges: consistency, availability, tolerance. CAP theorem, consensus algorithms (Paxos, Raft).
advanced_concepts.artificial_intelligence: Search algorithms, game AI, expert systems. Machine learning foundation. NLP, computer vision.
advanced_concepts.big_data: Hadoop, Spark, MapReduce. Process petabytes. Batch and real-time processing. Data pipeline architecture.
advanced_concepts.blockchain: Distributed ledger, cryptographic hashing, proof of work. Smart contracts, consensus mechanisms.
advanced_concepts.iot_systems: Connected devices, sensors, actuators. Edge computing, MQTT protocol. Data collection and processing.
advanced_concepts.edge_computing: Computation at network edge. Reduce latency, bandwidth. Cloudlet, fog computing concepts.
